articles.title: China industrial profits growth surges to a 5-month high of 20.1% in October
articles.summary: Electronics makers drove the profit gain, with earnings in the sector doubling in the first 10 months from the same period last year, as demand for AI computing power lifted memory chips and related manufacturing, said Yu Weining, chief statistician of the NBS. Commodity producers also saw sharp growth in profits as demand tied to renewable energy and AI pushed up copper and aluminum prices, Yu said.

articles.title: Microdrama apps chase profits as Hollywood moves into short-form, vertical video
articles.summary: Bogdan Nesvit says his mission is simple: "We are essentially building Disney for the 21st century." Nesvit is the co-founder of microseries app My Drama, built around the latest, bite-sized form of storytelling. Fox Entertainment was one of the earliest Hollywood investors in microdramas. Despite the flurry of investment, Hollywood still faces the challenge of how to translate viewing hours into profit, especially for shorter content.

articles.title: Semiconductor chips are the new oil. Here's why
articles.summary: The artificial intelligence boom has pushed semiconductors past oil and gas in global export value for the first time, according to a Deutsche Bank analysis of International Trade Centre data. Yet the milestone arrives at an awkward moment, just as investors reassess the outlook for artificial intelligence spending and drive down the price of semiconductor stocks. technology stocks, startups and data centers, further helping to finance the AI investment cycle.

articles.title: Nvidia chip buyers told to rule out Chinese renters to purchase GPUs, sources say
articles.summary: Chip sellers communicated the messaging to neoclouds after the announcement, which seeks to close an export controls loophole allowing Chinese companies to rent access to Nvidia's most advanced chips when hosted in data centers overseas, two people familiar with the situation told CNBC. Neocloud stocks have come under renewed pressure lately as investors questioned the sustainability of the AI boom.
